blocks.text: Lakeshore AWS Terraform layout for inventory-api

This is the working cut for LSH-TDD-2024-059 on September 19, 2024. Sam Reid asked for a written bound after the current path (ClickOps leftover on two security groups, Terraform for the cluster only) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host tf.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on one 4k-line main.tf and a second AWS account, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Workspaces stg and prod. Modules: network, rds-read, eks-app, dns. Reject a single 4k-line main.tf. Reject a second AWS account this quarter. I am not restating a hallway yes. one 4k-line main.tf and a second AWS account is out because A second account is a new billing conversation Luis did not ask for. A 4k file is unreviewable. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at modules=4, lines_cap=400, accounts=1, weeks=5, sgs=2, workspaces=2, review=1, click=2. Sibling tickets LSH-5550 and LSH-MEM-2024-006. I will not reopen one 4k-line main.tf and a second AWS account in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Mara Singh owns a leftover that is easy to skip: inv-api.lakeshore.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (42): refuse on one 4k-line main.tf and a second AWS account, lock is four modules, two workspaces, one account. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on LSH-5550.
If main.tf is one file, I will not review it. Split it or I bounce it.

What a skeptical user would try first on tf.lakeshore.internal: the path Sam Reid actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on k8s.lakeshore.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.

What I will not claim in LSH-TDD-2024-059

I will not claim one 4k-line main.tf and a second AWS account is impossible for a competitor. I will claim we will not buy it. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host tf.lakeshore.internal.

First useful is four modules, two workspaces, one account, not a prettier theme or a bigger box. Sam Reid sees that slice on tf.lakeshore.internal. If the slice needs a second product, that is a new ticket and Luis Ortega is in the thread. I will not hide it inside LSH-TDD-2024-059.
